rule: L3 rules. (a) a runner may not base an assertion on a ONE-SHOT observeFresh({ actionable: true }); a warp in flight is not a world that cannot be acted on (it cost a live run), so the observation has to be waitForActionable. (b) a runner must be reachable from a resolver declaration (or opt out inline with a reason), because a runner nobody can reach proves nothing.
ratchet: An unlisted (file, fact) site is red immediately. A listed site that no longer violates, or a listed site whose count dropped, is red too - so this list can only shrink and cannot rot. Remove an entry by fixing the runner.

classification.how: For each one-shot actionable observe, take the statement that follows it. A site is a violation unless every field that statement can read is actionability-independent. The fields are derived from the code, not from the callee's name: a callee is resolved in the runner itself first, then in tools/lib/stardew-native-smoke-harness-v1.mjs, and the fields it reads on its first parameter are extracted from that body. An unresolved callee is treated as reading the whole snapshot, so a helper that passes the snapshot wholesale is red.
classification.exemptBecause: snapshot.capabilities is a property of the Mod's capability surface, which no warp, modal or in-flight execution can falsify. Asserting only that is not the defect this gate exists for.
classification.measured: 11 rule-(a) sites in 11 runners, plus 4 rule-(b) sites. A rule-(b) violation's `fact` is the rule's constant (`not in the descriptor map`), so the FILE is the identity: each entry's `reason` records what world fact that runner asserts and why no resolver declaration can name it. Rule (b)'s reachable population is the union of the three declarations `tools/resolve-stardew-action-gate-runner.mjs` reads (published gate table, experimental/harness map, published-action gate exemptions); before that union, the exemption list went unread and `navigate_to_destination`'s declared gate was reported unreachable - a defect of the ladder's boundary, not of the runner.

consideredAndExcluded.why: reads only capabilities (verified by resolving assertRequiredCapabilities in the harness lib: it touches snapshot.capabilities and nothing else)

consideredAndExcluded.shape: one-shot actionable observe whose NEXT statement is not an assertion, e.g. `const settled = requireFarmTile(snapshot)` two statements after the observe
consideredAndExcluded.why: the approved rule is the IMMEDIATELY following statement; widening it to a window would be a different rule and a new decision

consideredAndExcluded.shape: helpers that poll: waitForActionable, waitForFreshSnapshot({ requireActionable: true })
consideredAndExcluded.why: already the required shape; the rule is satisfied by construction
